_comment: Issue #107: Help reference sub-page (settings_panel.gd). DATA not code -- content = data + code convention (CLAUDE.md). Each section renders as ONE wrapped Label, "heading -- body", the combined-line layout the sizing pass (issue #107) measured against HELP_TEXT_WIDTH/HELP_SECTION_LINE_CAP in tests/test_copy_fit.gd. Locks bind every body string: VERBS not formulas, no stats, no progress-toward numbers, no thresholds (opaque-until-sleep). First-draft copy -- controller voice-passes at merge (issue text).

sections.heading: Classes & Levels
sections.body: The Design tallies what you do; it writes classes and levels while you sleep — keep doing what you want to become.

sections.heading: Skills & the Hotbar
sections.body: Skills never trigger themselves. Toggle learned skills onto the hotbar, then use them yourself — in the field or a fight.

sections.heading: The Boards
sections.body: The Request Board and the Runner's Guild board post bounties and deliveries — accept first, then only what you do after counts. The Notice Wall just posts rumors and leads.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.body: Sleep is when it lands — classes, level-ups, and evolutions resolve overnight. The boards can turn over, and the day begins again.

sections.heading: Saving
sections.body: Save and Load live in the pause menu — three manual slots, plus an autosave after fights, level-ups, and doors.

sections.heading: Controls
sections.body: For the full key, pad, and mouse layout, see Controls... on this same menu.
